messages:
elaine: Heads up — release v2.7.3 is scheduled to go into the chaos change window at 03:00 PT. Deploy-bot just raised an SBOM provenance issue for a crypto provider dependency, and the vuln scan shows a medium transitive CVE. Need triage: pin vs exception vs rollback plan.

deploy-bot: AUTOMATED: Security gate failure for release v2.7.3\n- component: libcrypt-x86\n- provenance: MISSING (expected signed manifest)\n- digest: sha256:abc123def456...\n- vuln-scan: 1 x MEDIUM (CVE-2026-1234) in transitive dependency\nAction: require sec + legal approval to proceed into change window. See /policies/release-sbom for checklist.

samir: Can we do a canary with strict rollback criteria? I can watch the first 30m. What's the rollback playbook if the CVE is exploited?

rogers: If we can pin the digest to a verified build (or replace with libcrypt-x86:sha256:abc123def456), we should be fine. Quick option: patch in manifest and do a canary. Otherwise we need an exception and a monitored rollout.

elaine: Agree. Short proposal: allow canary (5% traffic) with immediate rollback thresholds and a KMS token rotation post-deploy. Rollback thresholds below.

eleine_placeholder
elaine: ```
canary:
  traffic: 5%
  duration: 15m
  monitor: infra + app errors
rollback_on:
  - error_rate_pct > 1
  - p50_latency_ms > 2000
  - increased 5xx spike compared to baseline
``` 

legal-team: Note — libcrypt-x86 is flagged for export-control review because it includes certain crypto primitives. If you proceed with a canary, we need an audit entry (who approved) and a follow-up legal sign-off within 24h. Link: https://redwood.company/policy/export-crypto

sec-bot: Suggested mitigations: token purge pre-deploy, rotate KMS keys within 1h after canary, enable detailed audit logging for all calls to crypto provider. Automatic guard: block full rollout if audit log collection fails.

devops-oncall: I'll queue a quick KMS rotation job and enable verbose audit. If you want the pin applied ASAP: run

rogers: ```bash
# pin digest in kustomize overlay
sed -i 's|libcrypt-x86:.*|libcrypt-x86@sha256:abc123def456|' overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml
kubectl apply -k overlays/prod
``` 

samir: I'm granting temporary approval for canary under these conditions: sec mitigations in place, legal logs captured, devops monitoring active. :thumbsup:

legal-team: Legal conditionally approves the canary. We require a write-up in the release notes and a confirmation of audit logs within 24h.

elaine: Roger. I'll update release notes and trigger the pinned deploy. samir + devops-oncall, please monitor first 30m and escalate to #incidents on any threshold hit.

deploy-bot: ACTION: schedule updated — canary rollout for v2.7.3 starting 03:05 PT. Gate state: PARTIAL_APPROVAL (sec + legal conditional). Will auto-halt on rollback triggers. Logs will be saved to s3://redwood-releases/v2.7.3/audit/

devops-oncall: KMS rotate job queued, audit logging enabled. Will post heartbeat in 10m.

elaine: Thanks everyone. If canary is clean at +60m we plan to promote to 50% and then full after 3h. If any doubt: pin rollback and cut a hotfix branch. :eyes:

deploy-bot: canary started at 03:05 PT. Monitoring active. Will post updates or auto-halt. :shipit:
